messages:
alex: heads-up — thinking about adding a per-route 'shadow' opt-in in the console so customers can route a subset of traffic to v2 for telemetry without affecting quota billing. want to float the UX and telemetry/quota implications here.
maria: interesting. so this would be a console toggle per route? who pays for the shadowed tokens? :thinking_face:
jordan: yep per-route toggle (and percentage). two immediate questions: 1) how do we surface cost impact, 2) how do we avoid double-counting in billing and quotas.
sam: from console-ux side we can show an expected token estimate + a cost delta preview before enabling. similar to how we preview canary spikes. quick mock: "Enable shadowing — affects X% of requests. Estimated extra tokens/month: Y (approx)."
lee: on quotas: if shadow runs fully we shouldn't decrement customer quotas twice. proposal: shadowed requests are marked as `shadow=true` server-side and excluded from quota accounting + billing, but still ingested by telemetry path. downside = extra infra cost for us.
alex: that matches my thinking. but ops wants to surface capacity impact to dedicated customers — they may need to reserve headroom.
jordan: technical sketch: route config adds `shadow_percent` and `shadow_variant` fields. runtime forks request copy to variant when RNG < percent. replicate headers: `x-redwood-shadow: route-123` so traceability. logs/metrics tag `shadow_route=...`.
maria: how about retention/visibility? product wants a dashboard that shows side-by-side quality metrics (latency, error-rate, lm-score) for v1 vs v2 for the route, with sample prompts. we also need an eval alert if perf regressions cross threshold.
sam: dashboard doable. need clarity on which evals run in prod vs offline. small sample payloads can be stored for comparison (opt-in by tenant). we should add a privacy checkbox in UI for storing prompts.
lee: alerting: create a separate metric series for shadowed errors so we can create an SLO guardrail. also, if shadowing is heavy we might need autoscaling hints for Dedicated customers (annotate tenant kube pools).
alex: billing note: we must be explicit in docs — shadow = no extra charge by default, but if tenant requests persisted outputs or longer retention for saved prompts we might bill an "analysis" addon.
maria: UX copy suggestion: "Shadowing runs model variant for telemetry only — responses not returned to end users and not billed. Enabling may increase system load; consult Dedicated docs for capacity guidance." add a confirm modal.
jordan: implementation caveats: 1) streaming responses: for shadow we should stop after first logit (don't stream), or run full forward but discard early? prefer full forward to get logits for eval but that increases token cost. we need to decide.
lee: prefer full forward for fidelity. but mark stream disabled for shadow copies to avoid client confusion. also put a cap: max tokens for shadow = 1024 by default.
alex: ok tradeoff — full forward + no billing, admin informed. can we add a sampling mode: "fast-approx" where we use quantized variant for cheaper evals? that'd lower infra cost but may skew metrics.
maria: include both: "accurate" vs "approx" shadow modes in UI with tooltips about bias. default to accurate for first 2 weeks of rollout then switch to approx for heavy traffic cohorts.
sam: checklist for console feature: toggle + percent slider, mode dropdown (accurate/approx), cost preview, privacy checkbox, confirm modal, access control (only owners/admins).
jordan: infra checklist: header propagation for traces, `shadow=*` tag in metrics, separate ingest stream for shadow telemetry (labelled), quota exclusion path, cap enforcement, ops alert if shadow-ing causes >5% increase in average token consumption cluster-wide.
lee: add runbook step: auto-disable shadow for tenant if their shadow tail latency > 2x normal for 10m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new feature flag `route_shadowing` created. PR opened: github.com/redwood/route-config/pull/881
alex: sweet. next steps: jordan to draft API + runtime patch, sam to mock console flows, maria to write help copy, lee to enumerate limits/runbook, i'll coordinate release gating. tagging @maria @jordan @sam @lee for followups. :thumbsup:
